comments.author: Line
comments.body_html: The dolls are incredibly detailed, faithful to the original, and perfectly capture the Tarkov aesthetic. However, the drop rate is far too high—so high that it severely disrupts normal gameplay. I had no choice but to uninstall it.

comments.author: Prometheus
comments.body_html: You can edit the Probability fields in “user\mods\Penguin’s Doom Toys\db\Items\Penguin’s Doom Toys.json”. The default value looks to be 500, so just do a find/replace - I’m not sure if larger or smaller numbers are “more rare”, but it should be easy to test.
